title: Causal-Guided Active Learning for Debiasing Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: Stereotypical bias detection, where religion is one of the categories of stereotype, grouped under 'cultural association of a name'.
findings: The proposed method (CAL) can automatically identify 7 out of 9 types of stereotype biases from the BBQ dataset without prior knowledge. Religious bias was one of the categories identified, grouped under 'cultural association of a name'. The method generally improves performance on the BBQ benchmark, suggesting it helps mitigate such stereotype biases.
